title: The stale-cite judge sees the symbol a 'read path::name' cite names
why: lint/stale_cites.py cited_excerpt shows merge.py lines 1-40 for a 'read path::name' cite; only the 'test path::name' form resolves a symbol. So the prose judge never sees the named symbol and can pass a stale claim.
note: Fix: cited_excerpt resolves the symbol for the read form too, from the same resolver the test form uses (one home). Red first: a read cite to a symbol below line 40 shows that symbol. Then re-score the judge.
